scope: Selected fields from a historical proof record, with source identities cross-checked against the frozen experiment index. Not a new proof or a self-contained replay certificate.

source_binding.basis: Frozen proof index and synthesis input manifest; current input and candidate bytes independently hash-checked on export.

replay_scope: Original and derived netlists, auxiliary proof circuits, tool snapshots and raw logs are not bundled. Obtain PA-30 inputs separately. These receipts support provenance inspection, not complete replay of all historical proof routes.
